book.name: Galɛshiaŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Galɛshiaŋ le

content: Kune banchi bɛ no ba lêesɛ fitele yi Kletu le
O ooo bamii ba Galɛshiaŋ, bɛŋ le la biyuŋ nɛ? Muh le wu noŋ loŋ bɛŋ le? Le gɛh bɛŋ ba ba le ba najɛ wa waaŋ no ba gɛ̀ ta Jiso Kletu yi kintaaŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ fi chuunyi andaŋandaŋ?
Ŋgoone ki mbîih fiɛɛ fimimia bɛŋ le. Kiyo ki Nyo gɛ̀ to yi ye yene le nje bɛŋ gɛ̀ gee no banchi duu noo nje bɛŋ gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu wa le la?
Bɛŋ le la biyuŋ nɛ? Bɛŋ kɛ fiɛɛ bɛ Kiyo ki Nyo, bɛŋ tu nyu wa mɛɛse lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ mɛ̂sɛ nyu bɛ bvuŋga bwena?
Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ baŋgɛ baaŋ achiji? Gɛ n'yɛne lɛ le achiji gɛ.
Nyo nyaa Kiyo ke bɛŋ le wu ka gee biŋgha bi mwɛɛ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ nje la? Wu gee noo nje bɛŋ gɛɛde banchi kɛnɛ lɛ le nje bɛŋ le bɛŋ yu wa saaka wù kune Kletu bɛŋ bɛɛŋ wu le?
Le no ba saŋ kune Ablaham a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: Nyo mo wu jo wu lɛ wu le muh wù chaaŋ.”

content: Bɛŋ yɛŋ la lɛ le bamii ba leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, le bo ba le kfuu chi Ablaham kibɛɛ.

Ŋwa wu Nyo gɛ̀ yu wa wu dunyɛ baaŋ lo lɛ Nyo lé wu gê wu jô bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ bo nyûme jialɛ sɛŋ a wu jii nje fitele fì bo le bo leesɛ yi ye ye le. Ŋwa wu Nyo mo wu fejɛ saaka wù joŋe wunɛ Ablaham le baaŋ lo wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo lé wu gê wu nôŋ kimbonɛ yi bituŋ le bichii bi yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le nje wo.”

content: Noo, fi mo fi nyu lɛ bamii ba leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, Nyo lé wu nôŋ kimbonɛ yi bo le no wu gɛ̀ noŋ tɛ kimbonɛ yi Ablaham wù gɛ̀ leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le.
Bamii bachii ba yɛde lɛ taŋlo bo nyû jialɛ sɛŋ a Nyo jii nje bo gɛɛde banchi, bo tuude nyu loŋ yi bikwɛɛ biboo le, nje ba le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wuchii wù chee gɛ no ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu banchi le gɛ,
wu gee gɛ no banchi bachii goone gɛ,
tu wu tuude loŋ yi kikwɛɛ ke le.”

content: Fi mo fi duunyi waaŋ lɛ gɛ taŋlo Nyo jô muh lɛ wu le jialɛ sɛŋ nje mwɛdɛ gɛɛde banchi gɛ. Le fiɛɛ fì ba le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Le gɛh muh wù Nyo le wu jo lɛ wu le jialɛ sɛŋ nje fitele fì wu lese yi ye ye le,
le wu wù lé wu kɛ̂mɛ kinche.”

content: Gɛ banchi kɛme fiɛɛ fì bo gê bɛ nleesɛ fitele yi Nyo le gɛ. Fi tu nyu lɛ, “Muh wù gɛɛde banchi lé wu chêe wu bîi gɛh nyu bo le.”
Kletu gɛ̀ be wu suuŋ besabɛŋ chiaaŋ yi loŋ wù banchi gɛ̀ to bɛ wu le. Wu gɛ̀ tuu baloŋ besa yi kikwɛɛ ke le, nyu no ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Loŋ le yi muh wù ba le ba shɛŋshɛ yi kite le.”

content: Wu gɛ̀ ge noo, wu lɛ kimbonɛ kì Nyo gɛ̀ nya wa Ablaham le ki tô tɛ fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ nje Kletu Jiso, wu lɛ besabɛŋ ba leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le kɛ̂mɛ tɛ Kiyo ki Nyo kì wu gɛ̀ ka wa.
Gɛ banchi taŋlo bo kûsɛ ŋka wu Nyo gɛ
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, besabɛŋ jô mbejɛ yi mwɛɛ mù bamii to bo gee aju achii. Nɛ bamii le bo seesɛ wa fiɛɛ bo ji leh, tu gɛ taŋlo muh kâ wu kûsɛ kɛnɛ wu tâa fiɛɛ fo gɛ.

Kune baŋka ba Nyo ba wu gɛ̀ ka fɛ Ablaham bɛ mwa wù lé wu gê wu bû a kfuu che le. Ba baaŋ saŋ gɛ lɛ, “Ba le fɛ booŋ bò lé bo gê bo bû a kfuu che le gɛ.” Fifiɛɛ duunyi lɛ gɛ nyû fɛ bamii le wesee gɛ. Fi duunyi lɛ fi jɛme kune mwa wu mumwaa, mwa wunɛ le Kletu.

Fiɛɛ fì ŋgoone ki ndû le lɛ, Nyo gɛ̀ bee wu ge ŋka wunɛ, biluŋ gɛ̀ fe gii yinɛh bɛ kicho mbaanshɛ (430) fɛ wu nyâ banchi. No fi le noo, gɛ taŋlo banchi ba gɛ̀ to ajiŋ ka bo kûsɛ maŋkaŋ mà Nyo gɛ̀ gwo fweele, wu lɛ fiɛɛ fì wù gɛ̀ ka wa lɛsɛ achiji gɛ.
Nɛ fi fɛnɛ le lɛ muh taŋlo wu kɛ̂mɛ kimbonɛ kinɛ nyu gɛh sege wu gɛ̂ɛde banchi, tu gɛ ka baaŋ lɛ Nyo gɛ̀ ka lo bamii yu gɛ. Geenɛ, Nyo gɛ̀ nya Ablaham le wu bii no wu gɛ̀ ka wu yu.

Fishaŋ fi banchi le la? Ba gɛ̀ taade banchi ki ba duunyi mwɛɛ mù bamii jiaade kɛge noo gɛɛne bude sege mwa wunɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ge ŋka wunɛ kune wu, lé wu gê wu tô. Nyo mo wu nya banchi banɛ banchɛndaa be le, bo mo bo nya chiaaŋ yi muh mu le lɛ wu fêesɛ bamii le.
Bɛŋ kee lɛ nɛ bamii ja bo seesɛ fiɛɛ muh mu nyu a bo ntɛnɛɛ, tu wu le fɛ bo le bachii. Geenɛ, Nyo le gɛh wu maa

No fi le noo, tu taŋlo nchi ka wu tɛ̂ɛnyi fiɛɛ fì Nyo gɛ̀ ka wa? Gɛ nyu no fi le noo gɛ! Nɛ nchi wumu gɛ̀ bee yu wu taŋlo wu nyâ kinche, tu taŋlo muh nyûme chaaŋ a Nyo jii nje wu gɛɛde banchi nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ.

Geenɛ, Ŋwa wu Nyo duu lɛ muh wuchii le nfwa a bimbefɛ kuu. Fi mo fi nyu lɛ ŋka wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka fɛ muh wù le wu leesɛ fitele yi Jiso Kletu le, le gɛh wuwɛɛ muh wù leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le wu le wu kɛme.
Banchi gɛ̀ bee njɛ ndɛ mwa

Gɛ̀ bee fweele Jiso baaŋ a to gɛ wu lɛ bamii lêese fitele yi ye ye le gɛ, bamii nyu a banchi kuu bo kaaŋ bo njɛ bamii ba ncha, bo chiɛɛne gɛɛŋ bu sege Nyo lé wu gê wu dûnyɛ Jiso bo le, bo lêesɛ fitele yi ye ye le.
Banchi gɛ̀ bee njɛ ndɛ mwa wù gɛ̀ shee bɛ bamii wu naji gɛɛŋ bu sege Kletu gɛ̀ to, wu lɛ bamii lêesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, fɛ Nyo jô bo lɛ bo le jialɛ sɛŋ a wu jii.
No Kletu le wu to wa bamii leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, tu gɛ besabɛŋ baaŋ chiaaŋ yi ndɛ mwa wunɛ le gɛ.
Bɛŋ ba le bɛŋ taashɛ bena ba Kletu Jiso, le wa booŋ ba Nyo bachii nje fitele fì bɛŋ leese yi Kletu le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wuchii wù ba le ba leesɛ wa a joo, ba taashɛ bɛ Kletu, le wu tu wa bɛ Kletu yi fiɛɛ le fimimia.

Gɛ muh mu ka nyume yeye lɛ wu le muh wu Bajuu kɛnɛ muh wù nyume gɛ muh Bajuu gɛ. Gɛ muh mu ka nyume yeye lɛ wu le nfwa kɛnɛ mwa yeh gɛ, gɛ muh mu ka nyume yeye lɛ wu le jwɛŋsɛ kɛnɛ kwɛse gɛ. Bɛŋ bachii le wa yi fiɛɛ le fimimia yi Kletu Jiso le.
No bɛŋ le wa bamii ba Kletu noo, tu bɛŋ le wa booŋ ba Ablaham, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ mwɛɛ mù Nyo gɛ̀ ka Ablaham yu.

footnotes.text: Fɛnɛ fi le a je a je lɛ Nyo le wu mumwaa.
